fullSurface.scope: Every selected glove triangle whose positive skin influences belong entirely to the same native wrist/palm/digit subtree; forearm cuff excluded and must be checked in full runtime arm pose

method: Damped differential IK of fixed source pulp material against explicit finite targets; no coordinate descent or parameter grid

index.method: Distal-to-proximal positive hinge closure to first actual descendant-skin contact;5degree swept brackets then30bisections, no multi-parameter fit

axisProvenance.source: native-hand-repair01/build-native.py and field-math.py derive thumb axes from global palm normal; positive small curl is tested, anatomical thumb pulp/hinge is not independently certified
